articles.title: Hobart City Council resurrects plan to block whole homes from being turned into short
articles.description: A fresh proposal from the Hobart City Council would block about 90 per cent of the city's homes from being wholly converted into short-stay accommodation. The plan is the latest chapter in a long-running push to rein in the number of rentals being lost to platforms such as Airbnb.
articles.content:
The once-quashed plan to block Hobart property owners from converting their entire home into a short-stay accommodation has been resurrected by the local council.

articles.title: Georgio Poullas, RAF star, arrested on aggravated battery charges after bachelor party
articles.description: Georgio Poullas, a star with Real American Freestyle (RAF) Wrestling, was arrested on aggravated battery charges in Delray Beach, Fla. on June 6. According to the police report, Poullas allegedly threw another person through a glass table at a bachelor party taking place at an AirBnb and the person suffered laceration injuries as a result.
